layman_headline: Fearful market with no clear entry — patience is the play right now.
layman_explanation: The crypto market is sitting in a fear zone with Bitcoin drifting slightly lower around $63,400. Most altcoins are flat or declining, and the few coins showing big moves (like CYS up 95% in a week) are dangerously overbought. The swing trade candidates this cycle are mostly stablecoins and gold-backed tokens, which aren't swing trade material. Solana is the most interesting candidate but lacks a clear catalyst or technical trigger at this price.
layman_action: Stay in cash and wait. There's no high-probability setup right now. Set alerts for Solana around $72-73 and BTC around $60,000 — a deeper pullback during this fear period could create real buying opportunities.
expert_reasoning: The candidate pool is exceptionally weak this cycle. CYS has an RSI of 86.32 — deeply overbought with 95% gains in 7 days, making it a short candidate not a long. BEAT is down 55% in a week and 90.8% from ATH with zero technical data — classic falling knife with no visible support. The stablecoins and gold tokens offer no swing trade upside. SOL shows relative strength (+2.3% weekly while BTC is -1.8%) but lacks RSI/MACD confirmation data and no clear volume breakout signal. With Fear & Greed at 29 (flat trend), the market isn't capitulating enough for a contrarian bounce, nor recovering enough for momentum plays. High BTC dominance at 56.3% continues to suppress alt performance. Discipline demands we wait for a better setup.

context_banner: Fear-driven market with weak swing candidates — disciplined patience beats forced entries in this environment.
